title: blue light glasses, real or placebo

messages.content: blue light glasses actually help or just placebo?? eyes feel like melted marshmallows here!!!

Blue light glasses are designed to reduce eye strain from screens, but their effectiveness can vary. Some studies suggest they help reduce eye fatigue, while others find no significant impact on preventing digital eye strain. Part of the issue might be from how you're using screens, like staring without breaks or having poor lighting.
so no definitive verdict?? need to know if they're just expensive window dressing!!

There's no consensus yet among researchers, so it's not a clear-cut answer. They might help with comfort for some users, but not all evidence supports major benefits. Also consider things like the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds. Simple changes can sometimes make a big difference.

If you're still experiencing discomfort, it could be useful to review your overall screen habits or even consult with an eye professional. While duct tape and flamethrowers are amusingly impractical, taking more regular breaks could help ease that marshmallow feeling without eyewear!
